category_title: Students with intellectual disabilities who exhibit disruptive behaviors (hitting, making sounds, damaging property)
scenario_title: Peer interaction and classroom rules compliance
minimal_context: The student is sitting with peers in the classroom and is expected to comply with class rules during a group activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our group activity. Please sit with your peers and remember to follow the class rules.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes different kinds of sounds and does not respond to the interaction.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try to be quiet and listen to the instructions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues making sounds, not complying with the class rules while sitting next to the other students.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit nicely with your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exhibits negative behavior by reaching out, pulling on their peers' hair, and hitting them.)
